name: L'Impression — anti-spam on the contact form
headline: Two spam levers shipped on a branch, not merged — they need your keys.
about: Started as the weekly menu sync, comparing the Lightspeed richitem API against the newsletter. Turned into the personal-inbox spam question: what measures are actually in place, whether a captcha is needed, why the other sites are unaffected.
stopped_at: Pushed 292bdae. ORIGIN_STRICT=1 rejects a POST with no real Origin header — all 12 logged spams forge Referer and send none, all 4 genuine submissions sent it. Turnstile is wired end to end, off by default, and fails open so a Cloudflare outage can never close the form.
next: Add the Turnstile keys, flip ORIGIN_STRICT on, then merge. site/.env.example is gitignored, so that edit is local only.

note: The ID you listed (0f03052d…) is an empty /remote-control bridge stub — 7 records, no conversation. This is the real session.

name: Climacool — AC rental opportunity
headline: Six-wave validation plan built. Everything hangs on turns per unit per season.
about: Assessing a rental-and-resale business for air conditioning units in French-speaking Switzerland, off the back of a record heatwave year. Started by reviewing the evaluation prompt for blind spots.
stopped_at: The Climloc reference case fell apart under the registry: SAS registered 1 June 2026, EUR 1,000 capital, zero declared headcount, no accounts filed. The EUR 1M and EUR 100k/day figures are unaudited founder claims, and there are allegations the operation was retail arbitrage rather than rental.
next: Wave 0 is free and runs this week: mystery-shop Louermaclim for ten units Monday, quote-only B2B prices from Climatlocation and CVC Systems, and send the supplier enquiries now. Below 3.5 turns per unit per season there is no business.

name: Spark — remote access after the disconnect
headline: Spark reachable again via sparkt. Open question is the iOS client.
about: Began as an investigation into why the pipe to the DGX Spark broke, ended with a working one-word reconnect (sparkt in Ghostty) and the whole procedure documented in the Obsidian PK Notes vault, plus a companion doc for phone access.
stopped_at: Termius account deleted, so the phone doc needs a new client. a-Shell ships no ssh at all. Secure ShellFish is the recommendation — no account, iCloud Keychain sync, one-time purchase, mounts the box in Files. iSH is the free-forever fallback.
next: Pick the client, then rewrite the phone-access doc around it.
